name: vibe-person-23-FOOTBALL
reading:
De Zerbi expresses delight and hope over Spurs' resilience and style

Roberto De Zerbi is portrayed as deeply pleased with Tottenham's performance, describing himself as 'very happy' and 'delighted' after a crucial victory over Coventry. He specifically praises the team's resilience and hopes their positive 'attitude' and 'mentality' remain intact. While one source notes his focus on Kulusevski's return, the prevailing tone across reports is one of satisfaction and optimism regarding the team's style and response to the match.
